headline: THE FORWARD PASS IS CAUSAL, WHICH IS THE PROPERTY FINITE LOGITS CANNOT SEE
boundary_this_closes: ACCELERATOR_RUNTIME_EXECUTES.json: 'finite logits from random weights is a WEAK correctness signal that rules out a NaN-producing graph and nothing more'.

prediction_written_first.boundary: ACCELERATOR_RUNTIME_EXECUTES.json: 'finite logits from random weights is a WEAK correctness signal that rules out a NaN-producing graph and nothing more.'
prediction_written_first.what_a_finite_check_cannot_see: a graph that IGNORES ITS INPUT entirely returns finite logits and passes. So does one that leaks information BACKWARDS in time, which is the exact hazard ACCELERATOR_CONVOLUTION.json already named -- a conv that reads t+1 CHANGES NO NORM, it just makes teacher forcing mysteriously easy and shows up nowhere else.
prediction_written_first.P1_determinism: the same token sequence twice gives BITWISE identical logits on all three.
prediction_written_first.P2_input_sensitivity: changing a token changes the logits. A graph that ignored its input would pass the finite check and fail this.
prediction_written_first.P3_causality: changing the token at position k leaves logits at every position < k BITWISE UNCHANGED and changes position k. All three are autoregressive decoders so all three should be causal, and Falcon-H1 is the interesting one because its Mamba mixer's causality lives in a width-4 conv this program has already built and controlled.
prediction_written_first.why_random_weights_are_legitimate_here: causality and input-dependence are STRUCTURAL properties of the graph, not of the weights -- a wrong-direction read is wrong at every weight setting. This says NOTHING about adequacy and does not touch the 2026-07-27 gaussian-proxy law, which governs grading compression.
prediction_written_first.how_it_could_refute_me: a model whose earlier positions move when a later token changes is NOT causal as built here; a model whose logits do not move at all is ignoring its input; either would mean the previous block's 'forward pass runs' was weaker than it read.

what_the_weak_check_could_not_see: a graph that IGNORES ITS INPUT ENTIRELY returns finite logits and passes it, and so does one that LEAKS INFORMATION BACKWARDS IN TIME -- the hazard ACCELERATOR_CONVOLUTION.json already named in its own words, that a conv reading t+1 CHANGES NO NORM and shows up nowhere else.
result: ALL THREE specimens that build are DETERMINISTIC, INPUT-SENSITIVE and CAUSAL. Changing the token at position 2 moves logits at positions 2 and 3 and leaves 0 and 1 BITWISE UNCHANGED; changing the LAST token moves ONLY the last. That is the autoregressive property, on the MoE core, on a vision-language decoder and on the MAMBA HYBRID whose causality lives in the width-4 conv this program built and controlled two dozen blocks ago.
why_random_weights_are_legitimate_for_th: causality and input-dependence are properties of the GRAPH, not of the weights -- a wrong-direction read is wrong at EVERY weight setting. So this is a real structural claim that random weights cannot mask, and it still says NOTHING about adequacy; the 2026-07-27 gaussian-proxy law governs grading compression and is untouched.

the_control_is_what_makes_three_of_three.why_it_was_needed: three of three passing is EXACTLY the shape of a check that cannot fail, a thing this program has sealed five times -- a gate blind to magnitude, a predicate accepting an all-zeros pack, a tie-break mutation on dead code, a coverage curve counting probed blockers, a shape fuzz reporting zero failures for four primitives it never ran.
the_control_is_what_makes_three_of_three.design: a bidirectional attention block, IDENTICAL but for the mask, run through the SAME check function.
the_control_is_what_makes_three_of_three.measured: CAUSAL moves [False, False, True, True]; BIDIRECTIONAL moves [True, True, True, True] -- it leaks to positions 0 and 1, exactly where a decoder must not.
the_control_is_what_makes_three_of_three.reading: the check demonstrably separates the two, so the three passes are evidence rather than a tautology.

shipped.execution_coverage: now carries deterministic / input_sensitive / causal beside builds and forward, with the comment saying WHY random weights are legitimate for a structural property and not for adequacy.
shipped.two_tests_side_by_side: one asserts the REAL Falcon-H1 config is causal (chosen because its config is on LOCAL storage and a test must not fight the operator's fill), and one asserts the BIDIRECTIONAL control FAILS the same check with a message saying that if it does not, the first test is measuring nothing. Both directions pinned, which is the rule this program applies to every control.

claim_boundary: ONE LAYER, RANDOM WEIGHTS, four tokens. Causality at depth 1 does not prove it at depth 44, though the layer is the unit where the mask lives.
TEXT PATH ONLY for both vision-language models; no image was passed.
Qwen3-VL still does not construct -- the one-field VL gap from the previous block is unchanged and untested here.
Determinism is measured WITHIN one process on one machine; nothing is claimed across processes or devices.
This is a CAPABILITY and STRUCTURE claim. No real weights were loaded, the storage gate is unchanged, and every weight-space caveat in the G048 receipts stands exactly as written.
no kernel changed and no performance claim moves.
